watch.summary: The streamer boasts about how good he will be at a mail delivery game before wildly swerving and knocking over mailboxes down the road.

beats.what: Creator claims he is going to be 'deadly' at the game.
The mail van accelerates to high speeds.
Creator goes silent as the van starts swerving wildly off the road.
The van smashes directly into a roadside mailbox while speeding.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I'm actually going to be deadly in this game, check this out.
watch.why: The comedic setup relies on hubris versus reckless driving, but the streamer's quiet reaction during the drive limits the clip's energy.
